study type: Prospective quasi-experimental pilot study with historical controls
cohort: The study participants were gravidae with fetuses diagnosed with left heart hypoplasia (LHH).
finding: Chronic maternal hyperoxygenation (CMH) was found to be safe and feasible, and while overall effect estimates on annular growth were small, more than 9 hours daily CMH was associated with better aortic annular growth in intervention fetuses.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at study initiation was 29.6 +/- 3.2 weeks for the intervention group and 28.4 +/- 1.8 weeks for controls.
